program.section_heading: Associate in Arts Degree and Certificate of Achievement: Technical Theatre
outcomes: Demonstrate professional behavior as part of team implementing technical theater elements for a production.
Demonstrate safe construction and installation techniques for technical theatre disciplines such as scenery, lighting, or costumes.
Analyze a script, paying particular attention to technical elements.

blocks.name: Plus the following courses for ten and a half units

notes: The section heading covers both the A.A. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; one requirements list and one outcomes list ('Degree and Certificate Student Learning Outcomes') are shared by both awards and recorded here.

The second block says 'the following courses for ten and a half units', but the five listed courses total 13 units (3+2+3+3+2). Read as all required because 3 + 13 + 2 = the printed 18 Units Required; the printed 10.5 is kept in stated. Reviewer should check whether this is stale wording or a choose-units rule.

No GE pattern or degree total is printed in this section.
